explanation: Raw GRU candidate n of unit 42 is set almost entirely by phase (about -0.98 at D1 and D2, +0.85 to +0.89 at GO; timing alone gives R^2 0.997). What is left over sits mostly at GO. (1) The largest single effect: on the episode first trial at GO the unit is about 0.84 lower (near 0 instead of +0.85). (2) At GO it rises with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (tanh(belief_lo/2); weight about +0.045 after an a1 trial, about +0.011 after an a2 trial). At D2 the same belief shape has a small positive weight (about +0.014). (3) Last-trial pattern at GO: strongly lower after a2 S1 u (about -0.12). Slightly higher after a1 S1 r, a1 S2 u and a2 S2 u; slightly lower after a1 S2 r, a2 S2 r and a1 S1 u (about +/-0.03). That roughly matches evidence for S1 vs S2 being good. (4) Two unrewarded trials in a row lower it at GO when the same action was repeated (about -0.03) and raise it slightly at D1 (about +0.04). The worst misses are late-episode runs of unrewarded a2 choices, where GO drops to 0.1-0.5, more than predicted. All terms are observed-only (no future, hidden or model-output terms). Test R^2 beyond timing 0.65 (dev 0.67), which is above the all-observed reference (0.59) and the all-cue reference (0.64), and above the policy-decile reference alone (0.39). So leaving out value/policy costs little or nothing here.

issues: The claims check out. Re-scoring the 8 terms on test gives 0.653 beyond timing, and the fitted weights match the stated ones: ep_trial0 -0.839, belief slope +0.045 after a1 and +0.011 after a2 (interaction weight -0.034), a2 S1 u -0.118, the signed last-trial term +0.029, D2 belief +0.014, the GO repeated-loss term -0.027, the D1 two-loss term +0.043.

Most of the score comes from one term. ep_trial==0 alone gives 0.139. The first 4 terms give 0.589. The loss-streak terms add little: removing both drops test from 0.653 to 0.623, about +0.007 from the GO term and +0.023 from the D1 term. 'Loss streaks' in the label is a minor effect.

There is a known, unfixed miss class: late-episode (t70-90) runs of unrewarded a2 choices. There GO falls to about 0.15-0.4 against a prediction of about 0.73, and D1 rises to about -0.4 to -0.64 against about -0.91. It shows up in the worst windows but is not large when averaged. Mean errors by phase x previous trial are all within 0.035; the largest is GO after a1 S2 r at -0.035.

Attempts to capture that miss gained little on test. A repeated a2 S1 u x a2 S1 u term (weight about -0.12) plus loss-count^2 x ep_dec scored 0.662. Loss-count x ep_dec, x late-episode, and exp(ep_trial) variants scored 0.63-0.65. The original terms are close to the best observed-only fit I could find with the 8-term limit.

The comparison with the references holds: 0.653 is above both the all-observed reference (0.59) and the all-cue ceiling including model outputs (0.64), so dropping value and policy costs essentially nothing here.
